systems.country_label: fibre networks overseen by the Libyan Post Telecommunications & Information Technology Company (LPTIC)
systems.owner: LPTIC, a state monopoly; regulated by the General Authority for Communication and Informatics
systems.tiers: National; described as extensive but disrupted by conflict and unreliable power, with limited rural connectivity; no local government office said to be on it

note: A study of barriers to e-government across Libya's public sector as a whole; local authorities appear only in titles in its reference list, and it states nothing about the connection of municipal offices.
